goalZh: 读懂一封简短的请假邮件:哪天没去、为什么、作业怎么补
canDoZh: 能读懂并写一封简短的请假邮件:说明哪天没去、为什么、作业怎么补

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Hi, this is Lei Zhang from your class.
lines.zh: (看完医生的第二天,磊给写作课的教授发邮件)您好,我是您班上的张磊。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I'm sorry. I wasn't in class yesterday.
lines.zh: 很抱歉,我昨天没去上课。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I was sick. I had a cold and a fever.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I went to see a doctor yesterday afternoon.
lines.zh: 昨天下午我去看了医生。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Now I have to stay home for two days and get some rest.
lines.zh: 现在我得在宿舍待两天,好好休息。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I'm getting better, but I'm really tired.
lines.zh: 我在慢慢好起来,不过还是很累。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Can I finish the homework next week?
lines.zh: 作业我可以下周再交吗?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I'm going to be in class next Monday.

questions.explainZh: I was sick. I had a cold and a fever.(我病了,感冒发烧。)

questions.prompt: 看完医生以后,磊要怎么做?
options: 在宿舍待两天,好好休息
questions.explainZh: Now I have to stay home for two days and get some rest.(现在我得在宿舍待两天,好好休息。)

questions.prompt: 磊在邮件里请教授答应什么?
questions.explainZh: Can I finish the homework next week?(作业我可以下周再交吗?)他还说下周一会来上课。

grammar.bodyZh: 给老师写请假邮件,按这个顺序写:① 问候、说明自己是谁:Hi, this is Lei Zhang from your class.;② 发生了什么,用过去时:I wasn't in class yesterday. I was sick. I went to see a doctor.;③ 现在的情况和请求,用现在时:I'm getting better. Can I finish the homework next week?;④ 道谢、署名:Thank you very much! Lei Zhang。提出请求用 Can I…? 比 I want to… 客气。说“昨天”的事都用过去时(was、had、went),说现在的情况别忘了换回现在时。

examples.text: I wasn't in class yesterday. I was sick.
examples.zh: 我昨天没去上课,我病了。

examples.text: I went to see a doctor.
Can I finish the homework next week?
examples.zh: 作业我可以下周再交吗?
